confirmedNewBugs.title: Pending editor content typed immediately before a collection switch is flushed into the wrong file: switching to an (empty) collection auto-creates/activates a new 'Untitled' file and the pre-switch typing lands in that file instead of the file it was typed in
confirmedNewBugs.feature: F04 collection switching x F07 flush window; class-adjacent to B221 (async boundary crossing) but new trigger surface (pending text flush x collection switch x file creation)
repro: 1. Default 'My collection' contains file 'Beta' (open, editor focused). Create a second, EMPTY collection 'Projects' (Collections... > name > Create).
2. In Beta, type real keys: 'Pending'. Within the autosave flush window (~<2-3s), click the 'Projects' collection tab.

3. Observed: app activates a NEW 'Untitled' file in Projects; __np3.doc().markdown === 'Pending\n', richHtml '

Pending

' — the typed content is now in the NEW file.

4. Switch back to 'My collection': Beta.markdown === '' (content LOST from Beta), richHtml '



'.
confirmedNewBugs.expected: Pending edits belong to the (file, tab) they were typed in; the collection switch must commit them to Beta BEFORE activating any other file.
confirmedNewBugs.observed: Flush writes to the post-switch active file; user's text silently migrates to a different file in a different collection; original file left empty.
controls: Timing control: type 'AfterSave' in Beta, WAIT 3s (autosave commits; Beta.markdown==='AfterSave\n'), then switch to Projects and back — Beta keeps 'AfterSave', Untitled keeps only 'Pending'. Proves the leak is exactly the unflushed pending window.
Plain collection switch without typing: no anomaly.
confirmedNewBugs.sourceMechanism: Collection switch handler flush path (Store.activate/flushCommit chain, app-js extract ~L1250s area; final overrides govern) — flush of editor content executes after the switch already re-pointed the active file / created the empty-collection placeholder; content written to the new doc instead of the source doc. (Mechanism statement to be pinned to exact symbol during adjudication.)
confirmedNewBugs.impact: Silent data misattribution/data loss from the user's perspective: text disappears from the document being edited and appears in an unrelated new file in another collection. Real-world reachable by typing then quickly switching collections.
confirmedNewBugs.fixDirection: Commit pending editor content to the CURRENT (file, tab) synchronously at the start of the collection-switch handler, before any activeFile/collection re-pointing or placeholder creation.
